column1: # The texts this code is measured against, kept in docs/ of this repository:
# the path of each in docs/, its SHA-256, and the version of the texts it
# belongs to, separated by tabs. A test of this folder fails while a text in
# docs/ differs from its pin. A text changes in docs/ by a ruling; this code
# takes the new version up by changing this file, with the obligations and
# the code the new version asks for, in one change.
